default-grid-type.name: Default Grid Type
default-grid-type.hint: The default grid type to use when making a new scene.

default-level-top-elevation.name: Default Level Top Elevation
default-level-top-elevation.hint: The default level top elevation to use when making a new scene.  Unset is +Infinity.

default-level-bottom-elevation.name: Default Level Bottom Elevation
default-level-bottom-elevation.hint: The default level bottom elevation to use when making a new scene. Unset is -Infinity.

cone-template-angle.name: Hex Cone Template Angle
cone-template-angle.hint: The default internal angle to use for the cone template on hex grids.

cone-snapping-angle.name: Hex Cone Snapping Angle
cone-snapping-angle.hint: The default snapping angle to use for the cone template on hex grids. 0 disables snapping.

cone-template-angle.name: Square Cone Template Angle
cone-template-angle.hint: The default internal angle to use for the cone template on square grids.

cone-snapping-angle.name: Square Cone Snapping Angle
cone-snapping-angle.hint: The default snapping angle to use for the cone template on square grids. 0 disables snapping.

line-region-padding.name: Line Region Padding
line-region-padding.hint: Add extra straight sections to lines to pad to the full distance on square grids.

line-region-rectilinear-corners.name: Line Region Rectilinear Corners
line-region-rectilinear-corners.hint: Add corners to line regions using the Covered Grid Spaces settings when Rectilinear is used on square grids.

cone-template-angle.name: Gridless Cone Template Angle
cone-template-angle.hint: The default internal angle to use for the cone template on gridless grids.

cone-snapping-angle.name: Gridless Cone Snapping Angle
cone-snapping-angle.hint: The default snapping angle to use for the cone template on gridless grids. 0 disables snapping.

collisions-highlight.name: Aura Collision Highlighting
collisions-highlight.hint: Show wall collisions on the current token level for aura highlights.

defeated-disable.name: Disable Auras on Defeated Creatures
defeated-disable.hint: Auras do not emit or appear on defeated or dead creatures.

reach-exception.name: Default Reach Exception
reach-exception.hint: Use the 10 foot reach exception as called out in the rules on square and hex grids.

angle.name: [Experimental] Custom Flanking Angle
angle.hint: Angle to use to consider an opposing token to be flanking.

gridless-override.name: [Experimental] Gridless Custom Flanking Logic
gridless-override.hint: Use the custom flanking logic on gridless maps. This logic checks the surface intersections points on an ellipsoid representation of the target.

hex-override.name: [Experimental] Hex Custom Flanking Logic
hex-override.hint: Use the custom flanking logic on hex maps. This logic checks the surface intersections points on an ellipsoid representation of the target.

square-override.name: [Experimental] Square Custom Flanking Logic
square-override.hint: Use the custom flanking logic on square maps. This logic checks the surface intersections points on an ellipsoid representation of the target.
